data.one_liner: International phone number input field for the flutter_form_builder package.
data.what_it_does: Provides a form field widget equipped with a country selector and automatic parsing of international phone numbers, integrating seamlessly with FlutterFormBuilder.
use_when: You are already using flutter_form_builder and need an international phone number input.
You need built-in country selection and phone number parsing out of the box.
avoid_when: You are not using the flutter_form_builder ecosystem.
You only need a simple, standard text field without country selection logic.
strengths: Supports automatic international phone number parsing via the phone_numbers_parser package.
Includes a built-0-in country picker and priority ISO code sorting.
weaknesses: Strictly depends on the flutter_form_builder package ecosystem.
data.minimal_example:
FormBuilderPhoneField(
  name: 'phone_number',
  decoration: const InputDecoration(
    labelText: 'Phone Number',
    hintText: 'Hint',
  ),
  priorityListByIsoCode: ['KE'],
  validator: FormBuilderValidators.compose([
    FormBuilderValidators.required(),
  ]),
)
